correctness.rationale: In characteristic two with the nonidentity involution of F4, Hermitian and alternate-Hermitian scalars and matrix spaces coincide. The source's Theorem 1.6 therefore supplies a nonlocal F2-linear alternate-Hermitian range-compatible map contradicting Theorem 1.7(a). The direct-sum count follows from nonlocality of Phi_0 and was exhaustively verified over all 65536 F2-linear maps.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The exceptional Hermitian map is prior work in the source paper; the claim here is only the internal contradiction, corrected alternate-Hermitian statement, and exact exceptional count. Targeted searches found no public erratum, revised arXiv version, or equivalent correction.

value.rationale: The affected theorem is advertised as the full linear classification and as input to subsequent bounded-rank applications. The correction supplies the unique missing case and its complete classification rather than only a counterexample.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
